_readme: The trailer script. Deliberately a different film from narration.json:
the long cut walks the lifecycle, this one throws punches.
Same two rules as the long cut — never read the on-screen caption aloud,
and no unusual compound words — plus a third: every line has to survive
being heard once, at speed, on a phone, possibly muted. The captions in
src/social.ts carry the story on their own; these lines add the swagger.
It uses a different, higher-energy voice than the long cut (see VOICES in
scripts/voice.mjs) — same script, same measurement, different delivery.
social-1-hook: Forty grand a year, and the customer said it was slow. On camera. Watch this.
social-2-import: Day one. The mess goes in as-is, and comes back as an event.
social-3-drag: Try to double book a room. Go ahead. Try.
social-4-cfp: You put the call for speakers together yourself. This afternoon.
social-5-comms: Sixty decisions, one release, and proof that every message landed.
social-6-gmail: That's not our app. That's Gmail, already offering the calendar.
social-7-warning: You never told it to check. It checked.
social-8-realtime: Left screen, right screen, same instant. Nobody touched anything.
social-9-publish: And the whole program goes public in one click.
social-10-close: StageStack. Open source, runs on your own servers, and never charges you per event.
